meta.notes: EDC Las Vegas 2026 (30th anniversary, "Under the Electric Sky"), May 15-17, 2026, Las Vegas Motor Speedway. 426 artist sets across 17 stages; ALL ends are officially published (0 null). Primary set-time source: festtimetable.com day-1/2/3 pages transcribing the official EDC app set-time graphics, cross-checked against fan clashfinders, DJ Life, DJ Mag, We Rave You, Review-Journal; conflicts resolved for the official graphics (see research notes). kineticFIELD production blocks (ceremonies/intermezzos/fireworks) excluded — artist sets only. Dusk-to-dawn format: 48 sets end after midnight (end_day set); 197 sets start after midnight with night = billed night. 17 stages verified from the official 2026 festival map, including bionicJUNGLE (new for 2026); "UBUNTU BY BRIDGES FOR MUSIC" appears on the map but published no set times and is excluded; a blog-reported "kineticTREE" stage could not be verified and is treated as a misreport. Stage colors are an arbitrary palette, not official. Map: original stylized geometry over Esri satellite; 9 main stages placed (approx) clockwise around the speedway oval per the official map; gates S/C/D/P (approx); satellite-verified landmarks (oval, grandstand, drag strip, bullring). Smaller stages/areas are schedule-only.
